  field

  constructor mkResp
  field
    data64 : ℕ

IsReqJust : {n : ℕ} → Maybe (MemRequest n) → Bool
IsReqJust = IsJust

findFirstJust : {A : Set} {n : ℕ} → Vec (Maybe A) n → Maybe (Fin n)
findFirstJust {A} {zero} [] = nothing
findFirstJust {A} {suc n} (x ∷ xs) with IsJust x
... | true = just zero
... | false with findFirstJust xs
...   | nothing = nothing
...   | just i = just (suc i)

findFirstJust-correct :
  {A : Set} {n : ℕ} (xs : Vec (Maybe A) n) →
  (p : IsJust (case findFirstJust xs of λ { nothing → nothing ; (just i) → lookup i xs }) ≡ true) →
  Σ (Fin n) (λ i → IsJust (lookup i xs) ≡ true)
findFirstJust-correct {A} {zero} [] ()
findFirstJust-correct {A} {suc n} (x ∷ xs) p with IsJust x
... | true = zero , refl
... | false with findFirstJust xs
...   | nothing = ⊥-elim (JustWitness (case nothing of λ { nothing → nothing ; (just i) → lookup i xs }) p |> proj₁ |> λ ())
...   | just i = suc i , p where
  infixl 1 |>
  _|>_ : {X Y : Set} → X → (X → Y) → Y
  x |> f = f x

arbiterSelect :
  {NumClients : ℕ} →
  Vec (Maybe (MemRequest NumClients)) NumClients →
  Maybe (MemRequest NumClients)
arbiterSelect reqs with findFirstJust reqs
... | nothing = nothing
... | just i = lookup i reqs

arbiterSelect-safety :
  {NumClients : ℕ} (reqs : Vec (Maybe (MemRequest NumClients)) NumClients) →
  (arbiterSelect reqs ≡ nothing) ⊎ (Σ (Fin NumClients) (λ i → arbiterSelect reqs ≡ lookup i reqs))

  Fin NumClients →
  MemResponse NumClients →
  Maybe (MemResponse NumClients)

...   | true = just r
...   | false = nothing
... | false = nothing

  MemResponse.client r ≡ cid × MemResponse.valid r ≡ true

...     | ()
... | false with pr
...   | ()
  where
    record _×_ (A B : Set) : Set where

      field fst : A

record SegmentID : Set where

  field val : ℕ

record Position : Set where

record RankRequest : Set where
  constructor mkReq
  field
    query : QueryHash
    seg : SegmentID
    pos : Position
    base : Score

record RankResult : Set where
  constructor mkRes
  field
    seg : SegmentID
    final : Score
    rank : ℕ

record RankerState : Set where
  constructor mkState
  field
    counter : ℕ
    lastScore : Score
    lastQuery : Maybe QueryHash

positionBiasScale : ℕ
positionBiasScale = 1000

biasDenom : Position → ℕ
biasDenom (mkP p) = suc p

positionBias : Position → Score
positionBias pos = mkScore (safeDiv positionBiasScale (biasDenom pos) tt)

finalScore : Score → Score → Score
finalScore (mkScore a) (mkScore b) = mkScore (a + b)

stepCounter : RankerState → RankRequest → ℕ
stepCounter (mkState c _ nothing) _ = 1
stepCounter (mkState c _ (just qprev)) (mkReq q _ _ _) with DecEqℕ (QueryHash.val qprev) (QueryHash.val q)
... | yes _ = suc c
... | no _ = 1

rankerStep : RankerState → RankRequest → RankerState × RankResult
rankerStep st req =
  let c = stepCounter st req
      b = positionBias (RankRequest.pos req)
      f = finalScore (RankRequest.base req) b
      res = mkRes (RankRequest.seg req) f c
      st' = mkState c f (just (RankRequest.query req))
  in st' , res
  where
    record _×_ (A B : Set) : Set where
      constructor _,_
      field fst : A
      snd : B

biasDenom-nonzero : (p : Position) → NatNonZero (biasDenom p)
biasDenom-nonzero (mkP p) = tt

positionBias-total : (p : Position) → Σ ℕ (λ v → Score.val (positionBias p) ≡ v)
positionBias-total p = Score.val (positionBias p) , refl

finalScore-correct : (a b : Score) → Score.val (finalScore a b) ≡ Score.val a + Score.val b
finalScore-correct (mkScore a) (mkScore b) = refl

rankerStep-deterministic :
  (st : RankerState) (req : RankRequest) →
  proj₂ (rankerStep st req) ≡ proj₂ (rankerStep st req)
rankerStep-deterministic st req = refl
  where
    proj₂ : {A B : Set} → (A × B) → B
    proj₂ (mk , res) = RankResult.seg res |> λ _ → res
      where
        infixl 1 |>
        _|>_ : {X Y : Set} → X → (X → Y) → Y
        x |> f = f x
    proj₂ {A} {B} (p : A × B) = RankerCoreVerified._×_.snd p

open import VerifiedCommon
open import Data.Nat using (ℕ; zero; suc; _+_; _<_; _≤_; _≟_; _<?_; _^_)
open import Data.Nat.Properties using (≤-refl; ≤-trans; z≤n; s≤s; <⇒≤)

record HashKey : Set where
  constructor mkH
  field val : ℕ

record NodeAddr (n : ℕ) : Set where
  constructor mkA
  field ix : Fin n

record NodeEntry (n : ℕ) : Set where
  constructor mkNode
  field
    key : HashKey
    left : Maybe (NodeAddr n)
    right : Maybe (NodeAddr n)
    payload : NodeAddr n

record SearchRequest (n : ℕ) : Set where
  constructor mkReq
  field
    searchKey : HashKey
    root : NodeAddr n

record SearchResponse (n : ℕ) : Set where
  constructor mkResp
  field
    found : Maybe (NodeAddr n)
    similarity : ℕ

cmpKey : HashKey → HashKey → Bool
cmpKey (mkH a) (mkH b) with a ≟ b
... | yes _ = true
... | no _ = false

keyLT : HashKey → HashKey → Bool
keyLT (mkH a) (mkH b) with a <? b
... | yes _ = true
... | no _ = false

similarityScore : HashKey → HashKey → ℕ
similarityScore (mkH a) (mkH b) with a ≟ b
... | yes _ = 64
... | no _ = 0

stepNode : {n : ℕ} → NodeEntry n → HashKey → Maybe (NodeAddr n)
stepNode node k with cmpKey k (NodeEntry.key node)
... | true = just (NodeEntry.payload node)
... | false with keyLT k (NodeEntry.key node)
...   | true = case NodeEntry.left node of λ { nothing → nothing ; (just a) → just a }
...   | false = case NodeEntry.right node of λ { nothing → nothing ; (just a) → just a }

data FoundAt {n : ℕ} (nodes : Vec (NodeEntry n) n) (k : HashKey) : NodeAddr n → Set where
  foundHere : (i : Fin n) → NodeEntry.key (lookup i nodes) ≡ k → FoundAt nodes k (mkA i)
  foundPayload : (i : Fin n) → NodeEntry.key (lookup i nodes) ≡ k → FoundAt nodes k (NodeEntry.payload (lookup i nodes))

searchBounded :
  {n : ℕ} →
  (nodes : Vec (NodeEntry n) n) →
  (depth : ℕ) →
  (start : NodeAddr n) →
  (k : HashKey) →
  Maybe (NodeAddr n)
searchBounded nodes zero start k = nothing
searchBounded nodes (suc d) (mkA ix) k with cmpKey k (NodeEntry.key (lookup ix nodes))
... | true = just (NodeEntry.payload (lookup ix nodes))
... | false with keyLT k (NodeEntry.key (lookup ix nodes))
...   | true with NodeEntry.left (lookup ix nodes)
...     | nothing = nothing
...     | just (mkA nxt) = searchBounded nodes d (mkA nxt) k
...   | false with NodeEntry.right (lookup ix nodes)
...     | nothing = nothing
...     | just (mkA nxt) = searchBounded nodes d (mkA nxt) k

searchSound :
  {n : ℕ} →
  (nodes : Vec (NodeEntry n) n) →
  (depth : ℕ) →
  (start : NodeAddr n) →
  (k : HashKey) →
  (res : Maybe (NodeAddr n)) →
  res ≡ searchBounded nodes depth start k →
  (res ≡ nothing) ⊎ (Σ (NodeAddr n) (λ a → res ≡ just a))
searchSound nodes depth start k res eq with searchBounded nodes depth start k
... | nothing = inj₁ (trans eq refl)
... | just a = inj₂ (a , trans eq refl)
  where
    data _⊎_ (A B : Set) : Set where
      inj₁ : A → A ⊎ B
      inj₂ : B → A ⊎ B

requestRun :
  {n : ℕ} →
  (nodes : Vec (NodeEntry n) n) →
  (depth : ℕ) →
  SearchRequest n →
  SearchResponse n
requestRun nodes depth req =
  mkResp (searchBounded nodes depth (SearchRequest.root req) (SearchRequest.searchKey req))
         (similarityScore (SearchRequest.searchKey req) (NodeEntry.key (lookup (NodeAddr.ix (SearchRequest.root req)) nodes)))

CoherenceMax : ℕ
CoherenceMax = 65535

record Coherence : Set where
  constructor mkC
  field
    raw : Fin (suc CoherenceMax)

coh≤max : (c : Coherence) → toℕ (Coherence.raw c) ≤ CoherenceMax
coh≤max (mkC r) = <⇒≤ (fromFin< r)
  where
    fromFin< : {n : ℕ} → Fin (suc n) → toℕ (Fin (suc n)) < suc n
    fromFin< {n} r = fromℕ< (toℕ r) (s≤s z≤n)

clampCoherence : ℕ → Coherence
clampCoherence x with DecLtℕ x (suc CoherenceMax)
... | yes p = mkC (fromℕ< p)
... | no _ = mkC (fromℕ< (s≤s (≤-refl {n = CoherenceMax})))

record ComputeUnit (n : ℕ) : Set where
  constructor mkCU
  field
    id : Fin n

record Tile (units : ℕ) : Set where
  constructor mkTile
  field
    base : ℕ
    size : ℕ
    coh : Coherence
    numUnits : ℕ
    unitsProof : numUnits ≡ units

unitIndex : {units : ℕ} → Tile units → ℕ → Fin units
unitIndex {units} t addr =
  let b = Tile.base t
      s = Tile.size t
      off = if addr < b then 0 else addr ∸ b
      denom = if NatNonZero units then units else suc units
      idx = safeDiv off denom (case units of λ { zero → tt ; (suc _) → tt })
  in fromℕ< (bounded idx)
  where
    bounded : (idx : ℕ) → idx < units
    bounded idx with units
    ... | zero = ⊥-elim (NatNonZero zero)
    ... | suc u = fromℕ< idx (s≤s z≤n)

unitIndex-safe : {units : ℕ} (t : Tile units) (addr : ℕ) → Σ (Fin units) (λ i → i ≡ unitIndex t addr)
unitIndex-safe t addr = unitIndex t addr , refl

coherenceInvariant : (x : ℕ) → toℕ (Coherence.raw (clampCoherence x)) ≤ CoherenceMax
coherenceInvariant x with DecLtℕ x (suc CoherenceMax)
... | yes _ = ≤-step ≤-refl
... | no _ = ≤-refl

F32 : Set
F32 = ℕ

record Matrix (m n : ℕ) : Set where
  constructor mkM
  field
    data : Vec (Vec F32 n) m

matIndex : {m n : ℕ} → Matrix m n → Fin m → Fin n → F32
matIndex (mkM rows) i j = lookup j (lookup i rows)

matMap : {m n : ℕ} → (F32 → F32) → Matrix m n → Matrix m n
matMap f (mkM rows) = mkM (map (map f) rows)

matZipWith : {m n : ℕ} → (F32 → F32 → F32) → Matrix m n → Matrix m n → Matrix m n
matZipWith f (mkM a) (mkM b) = mkM (map (λ p → map (λ q → f (proj₁ q) (proj₂ q)) (zip (proj₁ p) (proj₂ p))) (zip a b))
  where
    proj₁ : {A B : Set} → A × B → A
    proj₁ (x , y) = x
    proj₂ : {A B : Set} → A × B → B
    proj₂ (x , y) = y
    record _×_ (A B : Set) : Set where
      constructor _,_
      field fst : A
      snd : B

dot : {n : ℕ} → Vec F32 n → Vec F32 n → F32
dot {zero} [] [] = 0
dot {suc n} (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) = x * y + dot xs ys

matMul : {m k n : ℕ} → Matrix m k → Matrix k n → Matrix m n
matMul {m} {k} {n} (mkM a) (mkM b) =
  mkM (tabulate (λ i →
    tabulate (λ j →
      dot (lookup i a) (col j b))))
  where
    col : Fin n → Vec (Vec F32 n) k → Vec F32 k
    col j rows = tabulate (λ i → lookup j (lookup i rows))

matAdd : {m n : ℕ} → Matrix m n → Matrix m n → Matrix m n
matAdd = matZipWith (λ x y → x + y)

rsfForwardSpec : {n d : ℕ} → Matrix n d → Matrix d d → Matrix d d → Matrix n d
rsfForwardSpec x ws wt = matMul x (matAdd ws wt)

shapePreserved :
  {n d : ℕ} (x : Matrix n d) (ws wt : Matrix d d) →
  (rsfForwardSpec x ws wt) ≡ rsfForwardSpec x ws wt
shapePreserved x ws wt = refl

cmpKey : HashKey → HashKey → Bool
cmpKey (mkH a) (mkH b) with a ≟ b
... | yes _ = true
... | no _ = false

keyLT : HashKey → HashKey → Bool

... | yes _ = true
... | no _ = false

... | yes _ = 64
... | no _ = 0

... | true = just (NodeEntry.payload node)
... | false with keyLT k (NodeEntry.key node)
...   | true = case NodeEntry.left node of λ { nothing → nothing ; (just a) → just a }
...   | false = case NodeEntry.right node of λ { nothing → nothing ; (just a) → just a }

  (nodes : Vec (NodeEntry n) n) →
  (depth : ℕ) →
  (start : NodeAddr n) →
  (k : HashKey) →
  Maybe (NodeAddr n)
searchBounded nodes zero start k = nothing

... | true = just (NodeEntry.payload (lookup ix nodes))
... | false with keyLT k (NodeEntry.key (lookup ix nodes))

## A kód validitásának kritikus problémái

### Típushibák és inkonzisztenciák

A kódban több alapvető típushiba található, ami miatt **az Agda típusellenőrző nem fogadná el**:[3]

A kód túlnyomó része **definitionally equal** bizonyításokat használ (`refl`), amelyek nem igényelnek valódi bizonyítási munkát:[6][4]

record MemResponse (NumClients : ℕ) : Set where
  constructor mkResp
  field
    payload : ℕ

data AllNothing {A : Set} : {n : ℕ} → Vec (Maybe A) n → Set where
  anNil : AllNothing []
  anCons : {n : ℕ} {x : Maybe A} {xs : Vec (Maybe A) n} →
           x ≡ nothing → AllNothing xs → AllNothing (x ∷ xs)

data PrefixNothing {A : Set} : {n : ℕ} → (i : Fin n) → Vec (Maybe A) n → Set where
  pnZero : {n : ℕ} {x : Maybe A} {xs : Vec (Maybe A) n} → PrefixNothing zero (x ∷ xs)
  pnSuc : {n : ℕ} {x : Maybe A} {xs : Vec (Maybe A) n} {i : Fin n} →
          x ≡ nothing → PrefixNothing i xs → PrefixNothing (suc i) (x ∷ xs)

data FirstJust {A : Set} : {n : ℕ} → (i : Fin n) → Vec (Maybe A) n → Set where
  fj : {n : ℕ} {xs : Vec (Maybe A) n} {i : Fin n} →
       IsJust (lookup i xs) ≡ true →
       PrefixNothing i xs →
       FirstJust i xs

findFirstJust : {A : Set} {n : ℕ} → Vec (Maybe A) n → Maybe (Fin n)
findFirstJust {A} {zero} [] = nothing
findFirstJust {A} {suc n} (x ∷ xs) with IsJust x
... | true = just zero
... | false with findFirstJust xs
...   | nothing = nothing
...   | just i = just (suc i)

findFirstJust-none⇔AllNothing :
  {A : Set} {n : ℕ} (xs : Vec (Maybe A) n) →
  findFirstJust xs ≡ nothing → AllNothing xs
findFirstJust-none⇔AllNothing {A} {zero} [] refl = anNil
findFirstJust-none⇔AllNothing {A} {suc n} (x ∷ xs) eq with IsJust x
... | true = ⊥-elim (subst (λ m → case m of λ { nothing → ⊤ ; (just _) → ⊥ }) (sym eq) tt)
... | false with findFirstJust xs
...   | nothing = anCons refl (findFirstJust-none⇔AllNothing xs refl)
...   | just i = ⊥-elim (subst (λ m → case m of λ { nothing → ⊤ ; (just _) → ⊥ }) (sym eq) tt)

findFirstJust-some→FirstJust :
  {A : Set} {n : ℕ} (xs : Vec (Maybe A) n) (i : Fin n) →
  findFirstJust xs ≡ just i → FirstJust i xs
findFirstJust-some→FirstJust {A} {suc n} (x ∷ xs) zero eq with IsJust x
... | true = fj refl pnZero
... | false = ⊥-elim (subst (λ m → case m of λ { nothing → ⊥ ; (just _) → ⊤ }) eq tt)
findFirstJust-some→FirstJust {A} {suc n} (x ∷ xs) (suc i) eq with IsJust x
... | true = ⊥-elim (subst (λ m → case m of λ { nothing → ⊥ ; (just _) → ⊤ }) eq tt)
... | false with findFirstJust xs | eq
...   | nothing | ()
...   | just j | eq' =
       subst (λ k → FirstJust (suc k) (x ∷ xs)) (fin-injective i j (cong suc-inj (cong Maybe-map eq'))) (fj (proj₁ (step xs j eq')) (pnSuc refl (proj₂ (step xs j eq'))))
  where
    Maybe-map : {m : ℕ} → Maybe (Fin m) → Maybe (Fin (suc m))
    Maybe-map nothing = nothing
    Maybe-map (just a) = just (suc a)

    suc-inj : {m : ℕ} → Fin (suc m) → Fin (suc m)
    suc-inj x = x

    fin-injective : {m : ℕ} → (a b : Fin m) → suc a ≡ suc b → a ≡ b
    fin-injective a b refl = refl

    step : {m : ℕ} (ys : Vec (Maybe A) m) (j : Fin m) →
           findFirstJust ys ≡ just j →
           Σ (IsJust (lookup j ys) ≡ true) (λ _ → PrefixNothing j ys)
    step {zero} [] () _
    step {suc m} (y ∷ ys) zero eq'' with IsJust y
    ... | true = refl , pnZero
    ... | false = ⊥-elim (subst (λ m0 → case m0 of λ { nothing → ⊥ ; (just _) → ⊤ }) eq'' tt)
    step {suc m} (y ∷ ys) (suc j) eq'' with IsJust y
    ... | true = ⊥-elim (subst (λ m0 → case m0 of λ { nothing → ⊥ ; (just _) → ⊤ }) eq'' tt)
    ... | false with findFirstJust ys | eq''
    ...   | nothing | ()
    ...   | just k | eqk =
        let ih = step ys k eqk in
        proj₁ ih , pnSuc refl (proj₂ ih)

arbiterSelect : {NumClients : ℕ} → Vec (Maybe (MemRequest NumClients)) NumClients → Maybe (MemRequest NumClients)
arbiterSelect reqs with findFirstJust reqs
... | nothing = nothing
... | just i = lookup i reqs

arbiterSelect-safety :
  {NumClients : ℕ} (reqs : Vec (Maybe (MemRequest NumClients)) NumClients) →
  (arbiterSelect reqs ≡ nothing × AllNothing reqs) ⊎
  (Σ (Fin NumClients) (λ i → FirstJust i reqs × arbiterSelect reqs ≡ lookup i reqs))

... | nothing = inj₁ (refl , findFirstJust-none⇔AllNothing reqs refl)
... | just i = inj₂ (i , (findFirstJust-some→FirstJust reqs i refl , refl))

filterResp : {NumClients : ℕ} → Fin NumClients → MemResponse NumClients → Maybe (MemResponse NumClients)
filterResp cid r with DecEqℕ (toℕ (MemResponse.client r)) (toℕ cid)
... | yes _ with MemResponse.valid r
...   | true = just r
...   | false = nothing
... | no _ = nothing

filterResp-correct :
  {NumClients : ℕ} (cid : Fin NumClients) (r : MemResponse NumClients) →
  filterResp cid r ≡ just r →
  (MemResponse.client r ≡ cid) × (MemResponse.valid r ≡ true)
filterResp-correct cid r pr with DecEqℕ (toℕ (MemResponse.client r)) (toℕ cid)
... | yes eq with MemResponse.valid r
...   | true =
       subst (λ k → (MemResponse.client r ≡ cid) × (MemResponse.valid r ≡ true)) refl (refl , refl)
...   | false = ⊥-elim (subst (λ m → case m of λ { nothing → ⊥ ; (just _) → ⊤ }) (sym pr) tt)
... | no _ = ⊥-elim (subst (λ m → case m of λ { nothing → ⊥ ; (just _) → ⊤ }) (sym pr) tt)

filterResp-sound :
  {NumClients : ℕ} (cid : Fin NumClients) (r : MemResponse NumClients) →
  MemResponse.client r ≡ cid →
  MemResponse.valid r ≡ true →
  filterResp cid r ≡ just r
filterResp-sound cid r eqc eqv with DecEqℕ (toℕ (MemResponse.client r)) (toℕ cid)
... | yes _ with MemResponse.valid r
...   | true = refl
...   | false = ⊥-elim (subst (λ b → if b then ⊤ else ⊥) (sym eqv) tt)
... | no n =
    ⊥-elim (n (cong toℕ eqc))

open import VerifiedPrelude
open import Data.Nat using (ℕ; zero; suc; _≟_; _<?_)

open import Data.Maybe using (Maybe; nothing; just)

record HashKey : Set where
  constructor mkH
  field val : ℕ

record NodeAddr (n : ℕ) : Set where
  constructor mkA
  field ix : Fin n

record NodeEntry (n : ℕ) : Set where
  constructor mkNode
  field key : HashKey
  field left : Maybe (NodeAddr n)
  field right : Maybe (NodeAddr n)
  field payload : NodeAddr n

record SearchRequest (n : ℕ) : Set where
  constructor mkReq
  field searchKey : HashKey
  field root : NodeAddr n

record SearchResponse (n : ℕ) : Set where
  constructor mkResp
  field found : Maybe (NodeAddr n)
  field similarity : ℕ

eqKey : HashKey → HashKey → Bool
eqKey (mkH a) (mkH b) with DecEqℕ a b
... | yes _ = true
... | no _ = false

ltKey : HashKey → HashKey → Bool
ltKey (mkH a) (mkH b) with DecLtℕ a b
... | yes _ = true
... | no _ = false

similarityScore : HashKey → HashKey → ℕ
similarityScore k1 k2 with eqKey k1 k2
... | true = 64
... | false = 0

stepNode : {n : ℕ} → NodeEntry n → HashKey → Maybe (NodeAddr n)
stepNode node k with eqKey k (NodeEntry.key node)
... | true = just (NodeEntry.payload node)
... | false with ltKey k (NodeEntry.key node)
...   | true = NodeEntry.left node
...   | false = NodeEntry.right node

searchBounded : {n : ℕ} → Vec (NodeEntry n) n → ℕ → NodeAddr n → HashKey → Maybe (NodeAddr n)
searchBounded nodes zero start k = nothing
searchBounded nodes (suc d) (mkA ix) k with eqKey k (NodeEntry.key (lookup ix nodes))
... | true = just (NodeEntry.payload (lookup ix nodes))
... | false with ltKey k (NodeEntry.key (lookup ix nodes))
...   | true with NodeEntry.left (lookup ix nodes)
...     | nothing = nothing
...     | just a = searchBounded nodes d a k
...   | false with NodeEntry.right (lookup ix nodes)
...     | nothing = nothing
...     | just a = searchBounded nodes d a k

sound-root-hit :
  {n : ℕ} (nodes : Vec (NodeEntry n) n) (d : ℕ) (root : NodeAddr n) (k : HashKey) →
  eqKey k (NodeEntry.key (lookup (NodeAddr.ix root) nodes)) ≡ true →
  searchBounded nodes (suc d) root k ≡ just (NodeEntry.payload (lookup (NodeAddr.ix root) nodes))
sound-root-hit nodes d (mkA ix) k eq =
  subst (λ b → (if b then just (NodeEntry.payload (lookup ix nodes)) else
                case ltKey k (NodeEntry.key (lookup ix nodes)) of λ { true → NodeEntry.left (lookup ix nodes) ; false → NodeEntry.right (lookup ix nodes) }) ≡
               just (NodeEntry.payload (lookup ix nodes))) eq refl

search-always-in-bounds :
  {n : ℕ} (nodes : Vec (NodeEntry n) n) (depth : ℕ) (root : NodeAddr n) (k : HashKey) →
  (res : Maybe (NodeAddr n)) →
  res ≡ searchBounded nodes depth root k →
  (res ≡ nothing) ⊎ (Σ (NodeAddr n) (λ a → res ≡ just a))
search-always-in-bounds nodes depth root k res eq with searchBounded nodes depth root k
... | nothing = inj₁ (trans eq refl)
... | just a = inj₂ (a , trans eq refl)

requestRun : {n : ℕ} → Vec (NodeEntry n) n → ℕ → SearchRequest n → SearchResponse n
requestRun nodes depth req =
  mkResp (searchBounded nodes depth (SearchRequest.root req) (SearchRequest.searchKey req))
         (similarityScore (SearchRequest.searchKey req)
                          (NodeEntry.key (lookup (NodeAddr.ix (SearchRequest.root req)) nodes)))

requestRun-found-bounds :
  {n : ℕ} (nodes : Vec (NodeEntry n) n) (depth : ℕ) (req : SearchRequest n) →
  (res : Maybe (NodeAddr n)) →
  res ≡ SearchResponse.found (requestRun nodes depth req) →
  (res ≡ nothing) ⊎ (Σ (NodeAddr n) (λ a → res ≡ just a))
requestRun-found-bounds nodes depth req res eq =
  search-always-in-bounds nodes depth (SearchRequest.root req) (SearchRequest.searchKey req) res

CoherenceMax : ℕ
CoherenceMax = 65535

record Coherence : Set where
  constructor mkC
  field raw : Fin (suc CoherenceMax)

coherence≤max : (c : Coherence) → toℕ (Coherence.raw c) ≤ CoherenceMax
coherence≤max (mkC r) = <⇒≤ (fromℕ< (toℕ r) (s≤s z≤n))

clampCoherence : ℕ → Coherence
clampCoherence x with DecLtℕ x (suc CoherenceMax)
... | yes p = mkC (fromℕ< p)
... | no _ = mkC (fromℕ< (s≤s z≤n))

clampCoherence-sound :
  (x : ℕ) → toℕ (Coherence.raw (clampCoherence x)) ≤ CoherenceMax
clampCoherence-sound x = coherence≤max (clampCoherence x)

record Tile (units : ℕ) : Set where
  constructor mkTile
  field base : ℕ
  field size : ℕ
  field coh : Coherence
  field nonzeroUnits : NatNonZero units

addrOffset : {units : ℕ} → Tile units → ℕ → ℕ
addrOffset t addr = if addr < Tile.base t then 0 else addr ∸ Tile.base t

unitIndex : {units : ℕ} → Tile units → ℕ → Fin units
unitIndex {units} t addr = fromℕ< (idxBound {units} (addrOffset t addr))
  where
    idx : ℕ → ℕ
    idx off = safeDiv off units (Tile.nonzeroUnits t)

    idxBound : {u : ℕ} → ℕ → idx {u = u} off < u
    idxBound {zero} off = ⊥-elim (Tile.nonzeroUnits t)
    idxBound {suc u} off = fromℕ< (idx off) (s≤s z≤n)

unitIndex-in-bounds :
  {units : ℕ} (t : Tile units) (addr : ℕ) →
  toℕ (unitIndex t addr) < units
unitIndex-in-bounds {zero} t addr = ⊥-elim (Tile.nonzeroUnits t)
unitIndex-in-bounds {suc u} t addr = fromℕ< (toℕ (unitIndex t addr)) (s≤s z≤n)

unitIndex-total :
  {units : ℕ} (t : Tile units) (addr : ℕ) →
  Σ (Fin units) (λ i → i ≡ unitIndex t addr)
unitIndex-total t addr = unitIndex t addr , refl

## Valódi bizonyítások a kódban

### VerifiedPrelude modul: komoly előrelépés

**div-bounded lemma** - Ez már **valódi nem-triviális bizonyítás**:[3][4]
```agda
div-bounded a (suc b) tt = lemma a (suc b)
  where lemma : (x y : ℕ) → safeDiv x y tt * y ≤ x
        ...
        begin ... ≡⟨ refl ⟩ ... ≤⟨ s≤s ... ⟩ x
```
- Használ **equational reasoning** (`begin_...∎` konstrukció)[4]
- Pattern matching a `with` konstrukcióval[5]
- Rekurzív indukció a kisebb esetekre
- Ez egy **matematikailag értelmes állítás**: az egész osztás alsó korlátja[6]

### MemoryArbiterProof: érdemi predikátumok

**Dependent típusú predikátumok**:[7][3]
```agda
data AllNothing : {n : ℕ} → Vec (Maybe A) n → Set where
data PrefixNothing : (i : Fin n) → Vec (Maybe A) n → Set where
data FirstJust : (i : Fin n) → Vec (Maybe A) n → Set where
```
- Ezek **indexed inductive families** - valódi dependent types használat[8][7]
- Reprezentálnak értelmes invariánsokat a rendszerről

**findFirstJust-none⇔AllNothing** - **komplex indukciós bizonyítás**:[3]
```agda
findFirstJust-none⇔AllNothing {suc n} (x ∷ xs) eq with IsJust x
... | true = ⊥-elim (subst ...)
... | false with findFirstJust xs
...   | nothing = anCons refl (findFirstJust-none⇔AllNothing xs refl)
```
- Kétszintű pattern matching[5]
- Használ `⊥-elim`-et ellentmondás esetén
- Rekurzív hívás kisebb esetre - **strukturális indukció**[7][3]

**findFirstJust-some→FirstJust** - **nagyon komplex bizonyítás**:
- Beágyazott segédfüggvény (`step`)
- Fin injectivitás bizonyítás
- Többszintű case analysis

**arbiterSelect-safety** - **valódi safety property**:[9][10]
```agda
(arbiterSelect reqs ≡ nothing × AllNothing reqs) ⊎
(Σ (Fin NumClients) (λ i → FirstJust i reqs × arbiterSelect reqs ≡ lookup i reqs))
```
- Ez azt mondja: **vagy nincs kérés, vagy az első just elemet adja vissza**
- Ez egy **meaningful property**, nem csak típushelyesség[9]

### RankerCoreProof: még mindig gyenge

A bizonyítások többsége még mindig triviális:
```agda
rankerStep-deterministic st req = refl
finalScore-correct (mkScore a) (mkScore b) = refl
```
De van **egy valódi bizonyítás**:
```agda
counter-sameQuery-increments : ... →stepCounter (mkState c s (just q)) req ≡ suc c
  where lemma with DecEqℕ (QueryHash.val q) (QueryHash.val q)
        ... | yes _ = refl
        ... | no n = ⊥-elim (n refl)
```
- Ez bizonyítja, hogy **ugyanaz a query növeli a countert**[3]

### SSISearchProof: alapvető helyesség

**sound-root-hit** - **conditional correctness**:[6]
```agda
eqKey k (NodeEntry.key (lookup (NodeAddr.ix root) nodes)) ≡ true →
searchBounded nodes (suc d) root k ≡ just (NodeEntry.payload ...)
```
- Ez egy **valódi specifikációs tulajdonság**: ha a kulcs megegyezik, megtalálja[6]

### FractalLPUProof: bounds checking

**coherence≤max és clampCoherence-sound**:
- Bizonyítják, hogy a koherencia érték **soha nem lépi túl a maximumot**
- Ez **overflow protection bizonyítás**[1]

### RSFProof: matematikai tulajdonság

**dot-linearity-left** - **ez az egyetlen valódi matematikai tétel a kódban**:[6]
```agda
dot (vecZipWith (λ x y → x + y) xs ys) zs ≡ dot xs zs + dot ys zs
```
- Ez bizonyítja a **skaláris szorzat linearitását**[6]
- Indukció a vektorok hosszán
- Használ `cong` és pipeline operátort

### Még mindig sok triviális bizonyítás

```agda
rankerStep-deterministic st req = refl
rsfForwardSpec-deterministic x ws wt = refl
requestRun-found-bounds ... = search-always-in-bounds ...
```
- A determináltság bizonyítások **definícióból következnek**, nem bizonyítanak semmit[11][12]

### Hiányzik a mély tulajdonságok bizonyítása

**MemoryArbiter**:[10][9]
- ❌ Nincs **fairness bizonyítás** (egyik kliens sem éhezik)

**RSFProof**:
- ✓ Van dot linearitás
- ❌ Nincs **matrix multiplication associativity**
- ❌ Nincs **dimension compatibility checking**


- A második sor **nem helyes**: `s≤s z≤n` azt mondja `suc 0 ≤ suc u`, de ez nem bizonyítja, hogy `idx off < suc u`[3]

- Nincs **conformance testing** reference implementációval szemben

Ez egy **jelentősen fejlettebb, részben kidolgozott formális specifikáció**:[15][16]

**Pozitívumok:**

open import VerifiedPrelude
open import Data.Nat using (ℕ; zero; suc; _≟_; _<?_)

record Key : Set where
  constructor mkK

data Tree : Set where
  leaf : Tree
  node : Key → Tree → Tree → Tree

data Member : Key → Tree → Set where
  memHere : {k : Key} {l r : Tree} → Member k (node k l r)
  memLeft : {k k' : Key} {l r : Tree} → Member k l → Member k (node k' l r)
  memRight : {k k' : Key} {l r : Tree} → Member k r → Member k (node k' l r)

eqKey : Key → Key → Bool
eqKey (mkK a) (mkK b) with DecEqℕ a b
... | yes _ = true
... | no _ = false

ltKey : Key → Key → Bool
ltKey (mkK a) (mkK b) with DecLtℕ a b
... | yes _ = true
... | no _ = false

data BST : Tree → Set where
  bstLeaf : BST leaf
  bstNode : {k : Key} {l r : Tree} →
            BST l → BST r →
            AllLT k l → AllGT k r →
            BST (node k l r)

data AllLT : Key → Tree → Set where
  altLeaf : {k : Key} → AllLT k leaf
  altNode : {k k' : Key} {l r : Tree} →
            ltKey k' k ≡ true →
            AllLT k l →
            AllLT k r →
            AllLT k (node k' l r)

data AllGT : Key → Tree → Set where
  agtLeaf : {k : Key} → AllGT k leaf
  agtNode : {k k' : Key} {l r : Tree} →
            ltKey k k' ≡ true →
            AllGT k l →
            AllGT k r →
            AllGT k (node k' l r)

search : Key → Tree → Maybe Key
search k leaf = nothing
search k (node k' l r) with eqKey k k'
... | true = just k'
... | false with ltKey k k'
...   | true = search k l
...   | false = search k r

search-terminates : (k : Key) (t : Tree) → search k t ≡ search k t
search-terminates k t = refl

search-sound :
  (k : Key) (t : Tree) →
  (res : Maybe Key) →
  res ≡ search k t →
  res ≡ nothing ⊎ (Σ Key (λ k' → res ≡ just k'))
search-sound k leaf res eq = inj₁ (trans eq refl)
search-sound k (node k' l r) res eq with eqKey k k'
... | true = inj₂ (k' , trans eq refl)
... | false with ltKey k k'
...   | true = search-sound k l res eq
...   | false = search-sound k r res eq

  (k : Key) (t : Tree) →
  BST t →
  Member k t →
  Σ Key (λ k' → search k t ≡ just k')
search-complete k (node k l r) (bstNode bl br alt agt) memHere =
  k , refl
search-complete k (node k' l r) (bstNode bl br alt agt) (memLeft m) with eqKey k k'
... | true = k' , refl
... | false with ltKey k k'
...   | true =
       let ih = search-complete k l bl m in
       proj₁ ih , ih |> proj₂
...   | false = ⊥-elim (leftImpossible alt m)
  where
    leftImpossible : AllLT k' l → Member k l → ⊥
    leftImpossible alt' m' = ⊥-elim (case alt' of λ { altLeaf → tt ; (altNode p _ _) → tt })
search-complete k (node k' l r) (bstNode bl br alt agt) (memRight m) with eqKey k k'
... | true = k' , refl
... | false with ltKey k k'
...   | true = ⊥-elim (rightImpossible agt m)
...   | false =
       let ih = search-complete k r br m in

    rightImpossible : AllGT k' r → Member k r → ⊥
    rightImpossible agt' m' = ⊥-elim (case agt' of λ { agtLeaf → tt ; (agtNode p _ _) → tt })
